name: Overhead hands shot
summary: A fixed camera above a table that shows only a pair of hands and an object, so the viewer sees each step of an action.
how: Fix the camera at 90° above a plain table.
Frame the object at 40% to 60% of the picture height.
Show hands only; keep the face out of the frame.
Hold each step for 4 to 12 seconds.

origin.note: Gadget fans film the opening of a new device from above and post the clip, and the plain framing becomes the norm of the unboxing video.

adoptions.via: Gadget fans post top-down clips of new devices on video sites.
Close-mic channels use the same fixed top-down frame for tapping and sorting objects.
